conditions: word lists acquired in one of two natural environments and later tested in either the same or the alternative environment
task: learn spoken word lists and later produce remembered list items
temporal_scope: test follows learning after the experiment's prescribed delay

nodes.description: one of two natural environments present while the word list is acquired
one of the same two natural environments present when list knowledge is later probed
partition of trials into matched versus mismatched learning/test environment combinations
later test requiring participants to produce items from the previously learned list
number of previously presented list items produced at test
follow-up manipulation used to test whether disruption from moving between settings explains the effect

relations.description: the test outcome depends on the interaction between the environment present at learning and the environment present at test
matched learning/test environments predict higher test performance than mismatched combinations
the later list-production probe supplies the measured test outcome
the follow-up control separates a change-of-setting disruption account from the crossed-environment interaction observed in the main experiment
